messages:
nikhil: Heads-up: Zephra Labs wants a POC for their mistralx-40b-ft model. They want to validate latency and fidelity for a customer-facing chat with strict HIPAA controls. Requests: private deployment (VPC), customer KMS, embed-only vectors stored in their cluster, and a quantized 4-bit variant if quality holds. Can we support and what are obvious blockers?

rachel: We have an unvalidated catalog entry for mistralx-40b-ft (upstream name differs slightly). Main gap: their tokenizer is BPE with a custom merges file—need tokenization parity. Also licensing note: upstream license requires model-card attribution and has a non-commercial clause? need legal to confirm.

diego: From perf side: on Dedicated with L40s, 4-bit Mistral variants hit ~220ms P95 @ 256 tokens with single-request isolation. That misses their 200ms target. Options: smaller sequence limit, enable kv cache, or recommend 1x more GPU. For Private, depends on their host GPUs and interconnect.

kevin: HIPAA: Private deployment OK. We can do customer-managed KMS + disable persistent logs. For Hosted we can do limited retention but not ideal for PHI. Also need BAAs in place. Lia, can you confirm if Zephra signed our BAA draft?

lia: Not yet. I'm scheduling legal handoff tomorrow. Also Q: does Zephra want embeddings to be stored in their VPC only? We support that for Private; for Dedicated we can provide network paths but not full isolation.

deploy-bot: Build artifact available: https://ci.redwood/internal/artifacts/mistralx/40b/variant-q4.tar.gz (sha256: a1b2c3...)

rachel: Tokenizer test plan: run equivalence on 200 seed prompts and compute tokenization divergence rate. If divergence < 0.5% we accept; otherwise we ship an adapter or require them to use our tokenizer. @diego can you run on staging?

diego: Kickoff command I ran:
```
./tools/token_compare --model mistralx-40b-ft --external-tokenizer zephra_merges.json --prompts tests/seed_prompts.json --out results/mistralx_token_diff.csv
```
Result: 12/200 prompts differ, mostly around apostrophes and zero-width joiners. I can add a tokenizer-normalization layer in the adapter; low risk.

nikhil: Commercial things: offer 2-week free POC on Dedicated with optional Private trial (setup fee). If they want 4-bit quant, we can provide cost delta. Also need to surface potential quality delta in writing.

lia: Ops checklist: 1) validate q4 binary on Private image (ETA 24h); 2) confirm BAA + data flow diagram; 3) tokenization equivalence < 0.5% or adapter; 4) perf re-run with kv prefix caching; 5) draft POC SLA w/ latency objective and fallbacks.

diego: Note on caching: if they use many unique contexts caching helps less. For chat with repeated system prompt, KV does drop P95 ~30ms. I'll run two perf runs: with and without KV.

rachel: Legal note: license appears to allow commercial use but requires attribution and a copy of the license in distribution. I'll escalate if non-commercial clause found.

nikhil: OK team — priority: tokenizer equivalence and q4 smoke test. Lia, loop in Zephra infra for a short data flow diagram and infra spec. I'll send a short email with the proposed POC scope and pricing.

lia: Uploaded: Zephra infra spec request form -> https://files.redwood.internal/poCs/zephra/infra_request.md

diego: I'll attach perf numbers once both runs complete.

nikhil: Thanks — sync tomorrow 11am PT.
